authors: Casalia B, Vilacoba E, Lavinia PD, Tubaro PL, Barreira AS
title: UV sensitive vision in cardinals and tanagers is ubiquitous
why: Partial SWS1 opsin sequences across Cardinalidae and Thraupidae; abstract says every species studied has the UV-type sequence. The abstract page does not say whether Paroaria is in the sample. A gene survey, so it gives a predicted pigment class only. Already wanted by sweep-10 for Thraupis.
